::: {.csf-section}
<p class="csf-section__kicker">Then what</p>
<h2 class="csf-section__title">Before you come</h2>

::: {.csf-steps}
- ### Tell us about food
  Allergies, vegetarian, vegan, anything you can't eat. We pass it to the group
  and dishes get labelled.

- ### Decide what to bring
  One dish for 4–6 people. Stuck? The [recipes page](recipes.qmd) has options
  that need no oven and no talent.

- ### Bring a container
  For your dish, and for leftovers. There are always leftovers, and they are
  always good.

- ### Come on time-ish
  The first half hour is when introductions happen. Arriving with everyone
  else is easier than arriving late to a full room.
:::
:::

::: {.csf-quote}
Avoid the clubs you don't enjoy anyway. To meet new brains, just bring some chocolate with you.

<cite>— the founding principle, more or less</cite>
